file_purpose: Research and evidence profile for University of Dundee A100. This file does not replace the production admissions rules.

readiness.summary: Dundee can support eligibility guidance, verified international interview guidance, official historical admissions context, and a research-derived predictor model. International guidance uses a separate 60% academic and 40% national-decile UCAT pool with no fixed cut-off. Home logic is unchanged.

known_components.description: Dundee states UCAT SJT bands are not used as part of the initial selection for interview process.
Research data records standard entry pre-interview weighting as academic 60% and UCAT 40%. Evidence label: foi_derived.

Verified international evidence records a separate ranking pool using 60% academics and 40% UCAT cognitive total converted by national decile rank, with no fixed UCAT cut-off and no personal-statement shortlisting.
Verified international evidence records that pre-interview academic and UCAT scores reset after interview and offers are ranked 100% by interview score.
